title: Parking: every new question brings a parked terminal back, even when it already showed waiting
summary: Every new needs-you event (question dialog, permission prompt, turn end, Done, Error) now brings a parked terminal back even if its status did not change; the idle reminder still respects a re-park, and a question after an MCP finished report now paints waiting.
friction: the dev deleted an existing test whose behaviour the issue reverses instead of flipping its assertion in the same scenario; the gap let a regression pass and cost a review round
lessons_learned: When an issue reverses an existing behaviour, keep the old test scenario and flip its assertion; never replace it with rows that test a different scenario
